Gunmen have killed a 30-year-old man and injured his parents during a midnight attack on their residence in Nabai Fulani Settlement, Kargo Ward, Garki Local Government Area of Jigawa State. The attack occurred at about 3:50 am on Monday, November 16, 2026, when about seven unidentified armed men stormed the home of a 70-year-old man, Yahaya Jibrin. Confirming the incident in a statement made available to journalists in Dutse, the state capital, on Tuesday, the Public Relations Officer of the Nigeria Security and Civil Defence Corps, Jigawa State Command, ASC Badaruddeen Tijjani, said the attackers were suspected to be armed robbers. He said the assailants invaded Jibrin’s residence and assaulted him and his wife, Zainab Yahaya, aged 45. According to Tijjani, their son, Lawan Yahaya, aged about 30, was allegedly shot dead when he attempted to rescue his parents. Make PUNCH part of your everyday experience. The NSCDC spokesperson added that the attackers fled with a red Boxer motorcycle without a registration number and an undisclosed sum of money. He said the two injured victims were immediately taken to Garki General Hospital for medical attention. Tijjani further disclosed that the Garki Police Division evacuated the deceased’s body to the hospital, where a doctor confirmed him dead. “The deceased was confirmed dead by a medical doctor,” he said. The corpse was subsequently released to the family for burial in accordance with Islamic rites. The NSCDC spokesperson said the Jigawa State Commandant, CC Kabiru Ingawa, condemned the attack and expressed his condolences to the bereaved family. “The Commandant assured members of the public that the Corps would continue to collaborate with other security agencies to strengthen security, protect lives and property, and ensure that criminal elements are brought to justice,” Tijjani stated. He added that the commandant urged residents to remain vigilant and promptly report suspicious movements or activities to the nearest security formation. Tijjani also urged residents to provide credible information that could assist in identifying and apprehending the fleeing suspects. He reassured residents of the command’s commitment to safeguarding lives and property across the state. Salisu Kabuga
